  narrative: Met with Marcus and Elena from Valero Dynamics at their main assembly plant—they run about 4,000 employees across three sites and export roughly 80% of their turbine skids to South America and Europe. Target award date remains within the year before their fiscal budget locks in November.
</scenario>

  <item id="pd-001" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Pressure transmitter series PT. Resistance of the wetted parts to cleaning chemicals depends on the medium, its concentration and its temperature and is checked per application from the customer's data.</item>
  <item id="pb-044" type="playbook" source="Account planning practice for machine builders" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Notes in an account file age.   <item id="pb-031" type="playbook" source="Industrial sourcing practice" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Words such as unproven or reliability are used for both kinds of doubt.   <item id="pd-009" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Linear position sensor series LP.   <item id="pb-010" type="playbook" source="General B2B sales practice: qualification" version="1 (2026-09-30)">In machine building the engineer who selects a component and the person who releases the purchase are usually different people. An engineer's statement about urgency or available funds carries weight only after someone with purchasing authority has confirmed it.</item>
  <item id="pd-014" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Thickness measurement package TH. Two opposed displacement sensors with an evaluation unit, for sheet and web material from 0.1 to 25 millimetres thick, resolution 1 micrometre. <knowledge>
  <item id="pb-045" type="playbook" source="Export machinery practice" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Export-oriented machine builders ship against contractual delivery dates with penalties for delay. A late component delays the whole machine, which is why delivery reliability often weighs more than unit price in their choice of supplier.</item>
  <item id="pd-014" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Thickness measurement package TH. Two opposed displacement sensors with an evaluation unit, for sheet and web material from 0.1 to 25 millimetres thick, resolution 1 micrometre. Requires a rigid mounting frame supplied by the machine builder. Interfaces IO-Link and analog. Delivered with a calibration gauge.</item>
  <item id="pb-037" type="playbook" source="General B2B sales practice: negotiation" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Volume, contract length, packaging and shipment frequency are the usual items traded against price. When the customer has already considered them and the gap remains, only a change in the unit price closes it.</item>
  <item id="pb-036" type="playbook" source="General B2B sales practice: negotiation" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Machine builders calculate a component allowance for each part of a machine. A price above the allowance is rejected regardless of product quality. The buyer's target price usually reflects this allowance and has little room to move.</item>
  <item id="pb-049" type="playbook" source="General B2B sales practice: qualification" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Small machine builders are often run by an owner who decides on purchases personally. Larger builders separate engineering, quality, purchasing and finance, and each function holds its own decision right.</item>
</knowledge>

<knowledge>
  <item id="pb-003" type="playbook" source="Synthetic sales policy" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Lead times. Standard catalogue items ship within 4 weeks of order, configured variants within 6 to 8 weeks, custom variants within 12 weeks after drawing approval. The 50 fastest-moving items are held in regional stock. Confirmed delivery dates are binding once the order confirmation has been issued.</item>
  <item id="pb-026" type="playbook" source="Industrial sourcing practice" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Changing a component supplier exposes the customer to the risk of machine stops. Customers limit this risk by starting with a small quantity on one machine or one line, with the incumbent part remaining in use elsewhere, and extend the change after a period of operation.</item>
  <item id="pd-002" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Compact pressure sensor series PC for machine builders. Ranges from 0 to 10 bar up to 0 to 400 bar, accuracy 1 percent of full scale, response time 2 milliseconds. Overload limit 1.5 times the nominal range. Repeated pressure peaks above the overload limit shorten service life, so peak height and duration at start-up are part of the application check. Wetted parts 316L stainless steel. M12 connector or cable outlet. Protection IP65 and IP67.</item>
  <item id="pd-001" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Pressure transmitter series PT. Measuring ranges from 0 to 1 bar up to 0 to 600 bar, accuracy 0.5 percent of full scale. Overload limit twice the nominal range, burst pressure three times the nominal range. Wetted parts are 316L stainless steel with an FKM seal; an EPDM seal is available. Medium temperature minus 20 to 100 degrees Celsius. Outputs 4 to 20 mA, 0 to 10 V, IO-Link. Protection IP67. Resistance of the wetted parts to cleaning chemicals depends on the medium, its concentration and its temperature and is checked per application from the customer's data.</item>
  <item id="pb-042" type="playbook" source="Account planning practice for machine builders" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Exclusive supply agreements are honoured until they expire. Some oblige the customer to report competing offers to the incumbent, which is why customers under such agreements ask to receive no quotations.</item>
</knowledge>
<scenario>
  sales_stage: negotiation
  customer_size: medium
  export_oriented: false
  has_incumbent: true
  pain_points: incumbent's erratic lead times
  objections: none
  narrative: Met with Dave, procurement mgr at Apex Fluid Systems (mid-sized domestic integrator, ~180 staff, builds wastewater skids strictly for municipal utilities across the state). We're in final commercial contract negotiations to replace their current sensor vendor, Delta Controls, because of the incumbent's erratic lead times. Dave mentioned their facility parking lot was being repaved this morning, so we had to park down the road. They are planning to sign off and issue the PO within the year, specifically aiming for an October delivery for their upcoming Q4 build cycle. We reviewed the contract terms and warranty clauses line by line. Dave didn't raise any objections to our pricing structure, payment terms, or delivery framework. Spec-wise, the end customer asks for a manufacturer's declaration of materials for the level sensor's wetted parts. The customer states that this requirement could be revised if there is a good reason. Dave confirmed all other sensor parameters for the fluid tanks match their standard blueprint. He brought out coffee from the breakroom and noted their company summer shutdown begins next Friday.
</scenario>

M12 connector or cable outlet. Protection IP65 and IP67.</item>
  <item id="pd-007" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Photoelectric sensor series OP. Diffuse, retro-reflective and through-beam versions with sensing ranges up to 12 metres. A contamination output signals when dust on the lens reduces the signal reserve. Rated values are laboratory values with clean optics; detection stability in dusty processes depends on cleaning intervals and the chosen signal reserve. Protection IP67. Response time 0.5 milliseconds.</item>
  <item id="pd-001" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Pressure transmitter series PT. Doubt about a supplier concerns whether the company understands the customer's industry and will support it.</item>
  <item id="pb-034" type="playbook" source="Supplier qualification practice in manufacturing" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Audit calendars of quality departments fill weeks in advance. The date of the audit often determines the date of the first order more than any commercial discussion.</item>
  <item id="pb-028" type="playbook" source="Industrial sourcing practice" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Evidence from the customer's own process answers doubt about a product. Evidence from comparable customers answers doubt about a supplier. Customers who doubt the supplier rarely make machine time or staff available for testing until that doubt is addressed.</item>
</knowledge>

  <item id="pb-022" type="playbook" source="Industrial sensor application practice" version="1 (2026-09-30)">A change to the specification during commercial discussions reopens the technical acceptance. Prices agreed for the earlier specification may not hold for the changed one.</item>
  <item id="pd-018" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Connection technology. Sensors are available with M8 and M12 connectors or with a moulded cable of 2, 5 or 10 metres. Pre-assembled cordsets in PVC and PUR. Connector orientation and cable outlet direction are fixed per series. Customer-specific connectors count as a custom variant with the same minimum quantity as a custom housing.</item>
  <item id="pd-002" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Compact pressure sensor series PC for machine builders. Ranges from 0 to 10 bar up to 0 to 400 bar, accuracy 1 percent of full scale, response time 2 milliseconds. Overload limit 1.5 times the nominal range. Repeated pressure peaks above the overload limit shorten service life, so peak height and duration at start-up are part of the application check. Wetted parts 316L stainless steel. M12 connector or cable outlet. Protection IP65 and IP67.</item>
  <item id="pb-018" type="playbook" source="Industrial sensor application practice" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Some installation questions cannot be answered from documents. Clearances around moving parts, cable routes and access for maintenance are often not recorded in any drawing and are established by measuring at the machine, typically during a maintenance stop.</item>
  <item id="pd-008" type="product" source="Synthetic product record" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Rotary encoder series RE. Incremental output only, TTL or HTL, up to 5,000 pulses per revolution, shaft and hollow-shaft versions, speed up to 6,000 revolutions per minute. Position information is lost when power is removed, so the machine performs a homing movement after power-up. The company offers no absolute rotary encoder, no accessory that retains position through a power loss, and has no absolute version planned.</item>
</knowledge>

  objections: none
  narrative: Reviewed our sensor proposal with Martin at Apex Motion Systems this morning over coffee. They are a 14-person OEM building specialized wire-forming rigs, exporting roughly 85% of their production to clients in Germany and Japan. Their facility was noisy today because contractors were repaving the main loading bay outside. Currently, they source displacement and rotary sensors from Altus Sensorik. Martin mentioned their primary frustration with the existing units is cable wear during overseas container shipping. On the technical side, the machine runs a homing movement after every power-up, so incremental signals from the rotary sensor are sufficient. The customer states that this requirement could be revised if there is a good reason. Martin had no objections to the quoted unit rates, lead times, or commercial terms in our proposal. However, they have no purchasing plan or fixed schedule to place a PO. Their management has not approved capital for the next build run, and Martin noted they are simply holding onto our quote until a new project timeline gets defined down the road.
</scenario>

  <item id="pb-027" type="playbook" source="Adapted from SPIN Selling: distinguishing customer concerns" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Doubt about a product and doubt about a supplier are different concerns. Doubt about a product concerns behaviour in the customer's own process: stability over a shift, in dust, through repeated starts. Doubt about a supplier concerns whether the company understands the customer's industry and will support it.</item>
  <item id="pb-014" type="playbook" source="General B2B sales practice: qualification" version="1 (2026-09-30)">Shared programmes between divisions of a large manufacturer frequently stall on the question of which division carries a component in its budget. A technical approval does not settle this question.</item>
